'''Squad three''' was a formation of four [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]] assigned to the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]]. They were deployed during the [[Assault on Protazk|assault]] on [[Protazk]], where they were detailed to eliminate an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base alongside other elements of the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]. During the battle, the squad eliminated a number of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and overrun a trench. One tank was destroyed by a hidden [[Laser/Legends|laser]] tower during the assault, and [[Hammer 3:2]], under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Arbmab/Legends|Arbmab]] and driven by [[Gortz]], suffered damage to the port [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] that required technical assistance.<ref name="Protazk" />
